name: FinBen
description: A holistic financial LLM benchmark grounded in the Cattell-Horn-Carroll (CHC) theory of cognitive abilities, covering 23 financial tasks across 35 datasets. Tasks span numerical reasoning, text analysis, relation extraction, question answering, stock trading, sentiment analysis, credit scoring, and risk management. Represents the broadest financial AI evaluation framework available.
typical_sota_score: Varies significantly by task; ~60–75% on knowledge-based tasks; trading tasks show larger gaps
reputation: Presented at NeurIPS 2024; most comprehensive financial benchmark; CHC theoretical grounding adds psychological validity; used in Open Financial LLM Leaderboard; covers 23 tasks across 35 datasets
notes: Presented at NeurIPS 2024. Based on CHC theory providing a psychologically grounded framework for evaluating financial intelligence. Covers diverse financial modalities: NLP tasks (sentiment, summarization), quantitative tasks (numerical reasoning, forecasting), and decision tasks (trading, portfolio management). XFinBench (2025) shows a 12.5% gap between o1 and human financial experts.
